start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Crown Is Heavy
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The throne of David is yours.
The kingdom waits for your first word.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] A king's pride blinds his sight.
[TODO:pt-BR] Wealth is not what God seeks.

boast_consequence.text:

Kneel before the One who gives.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You set out at first light.

gold_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A throne built on greed will crack.
Seek God before all else.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You leave the treasury behind.

gibeon.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A thousand offerings rise from the altar.
The sky burns soft and gold.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] The Lord receives a quiet flame.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Offer to be seen by men
choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Worship is not for crowds.

seen_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] For God Alone
seen_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The altar is not a stage.
Give what only the Lord will see.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Your voice softens to a whisper.

dream.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Ask What I Shall Give
dream.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] In sleep, a voice fills the sky.
"Ask what I shall give you."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Riches will not lead a people.
[TODO:pt-BR] Power without wisdom destroys.
[TODO:pt-BR] Wisdom is the greatest gift.

riches_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Choose Higher
riches_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Gold cannot judge between right and wrong.
Ask for something greater.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Your voice trembles with humility.

enemies_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Long life and victory pass away.
Ask for what endures.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You bow lower in the dream.

granted.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Wisdom and More
granted.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] "Because you asked this, I give it.
And riches and honor also."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Wisdom kept in pride is lost.
[TODO:pt-BR] True wisdom acts in love.

boast2_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Walk in Humility
boast2_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] A wise heart speaks little of itself.
Return quietly to your throne.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Dawn finds you ready.

judgment.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Two women claim the same living child.
The court watches in silence.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Truth is not measured in volume.
[TODO:pt-BR] Wisdom asks deeper questions.
[TODO:pt-BR] True love will reveal itself.

loud_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Anger and grief sound the same.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You raise your sword as a test.

lots_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Chance does not bring justice.
Let wisdom find the truth.

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] You frame your test with care.

kingdom.text:
